text:
Lindqvist Dairy has recalled its oat yoghurt after routine testing found undeclared allergen traces, the company confirmed on 14 March 2025.

A total of 18,400 units of the 450 g tubs are affected. The withdrawal follows Recall Notice LD-2025-031, issued by the Northvale Food Standards Board.

Henrik Aalvik, Head of Quality Assurance at Lindqvist Dairy, confirmed the withdrawal. "We acted as soon as the test results were confirmed," he said. "Customers who have bought the product should not eat it and should return it to the place of purchase."

The notice states that the recall was prompted by traces of an allergen that does not appear on the product label. People with allergies are at particular risk of a reaction if they consume the yoghurt.

Shops stocking the oat yoghurt have been told to remove the tubs from sale. Consumers with questions can contact Lindqvist Dairy directly.
